scope_note: Evaluation protocol only. No RTL edits, no primary-file edits, no optimizer or EDA runs launched. The 24-call comparison pool expansion is PENDING; this manifest freezes the rules it must follow when it is built.
feasibility_rule: SUCCESS/FEASIBLE + DRC==0 + setup_ws>=0 + hold_ws>=0 + hold_vio==0 + routing==100 + overflow==0 + LVS + signoff + missing==[]

objective.normalization: min-max over frozen pool baselines below; critical_delay_ns = clock_period_ns - setup_ws
objective.scope: feasible-only; infeasible outcomes carry qor=null under FlowGuard drivers and the predeclared penalty 1.0 under vanilla BO ranking

methods.label: Vanilla penalty BO
methods.policy: GP on all observed trials with infeasible trials mapped to INFEASIBLE_PENALTY=1.0; acquisition is plain EI with p_feas=1.0 and no calibration

methods.label: FlowGuard-Calibrated
methods.policy: feasible-only QoR GP with EI multiplied by P(feasible) from RF feasibility model; RF calibrates (sigmoid, cv=3) only when each class has >=3 samples, else uncalibrated fallback; no hard risk threshold

methods.label: EI-only ablation
methods.driver: GP EI without feasibility model (ablates the EI x P(feasible) constraint)
methods.policy: feasible-only QoR GP with plain EI ranking and p_feas fixed to 1.0; no feasibility classifier, no calibration, no penalty mapping; isolates the value of the feasibility gate versus Vanilla penalty BO and FlowGuard-Calibrated
